entities.name: Methyl arylacetate
observations: Decoded reactant contains a methyl ester motif, COC(=O)CH2–Ar, in a complex fluorinated sulfonamide scaffold.
The structure was decoded from the supplied SELFIES and canonicalized with RDKit.

entities.name: Arylacetic acid
observations: Decoded product contains the corresponding carboxylic acid motif, HOOC–CH2–Ar, with the fluorinated sulfonamide scaffold otherwise retained.
The structure was decoded from the supplied SELFIES and canonicalized with RDKit.

entities.name: Methyl ester hydrolysis
observations: Net transformation is methyl ester deprotection or saponification: ArCH2CO2Me becomes ArCH2CO2H.
No other clear covalent changes were observed in the decoded structures.
